source: VIRTUAL SHIZUOKA 2019 LP orthophoto 20 cm (CC BY 4.0, Shizuoka Prefecture)
rasterSampling: BBox describes outer pixel edges; bilinear array indices subtract 0.5 on both axes.
limitations: Plan position is traced from 2019 orthophoto, not a current survey.
Curb height/cross-section are illustrative, not measured.
White/shadow gaps interpolate between observed red paint; inspect audit overlays.
Road edges outside the hairpin are automatic candidates, not individually reviewed.

reviewedRoadCandidateWindows.reason: Starting-grid white box competes with a continuously visible road-edge line.
Isolated road-side white candidate before the curb competes with the continuous edge. Broad white curb onset can leave an unobserved section.

reviewedRoadCandidatePolicy: Select source-observed runs inside reviewed bands; missing paint interpolates between retained observations. No GPS input; not survey control.

refinement.method: World-XZ second-difference regularization; observed red-paint weighted; variable width retained; centre paint resampled from native orthophoto

rejectedCurbSpans.method: interpolate rejected centre/normal; retain each observed variable width

rejectedGeometrySpans.reason: reversed section rejected; neighbours interpolated; not an independent accuracy measurement
reversed section rejected; neighbours interpolated; not an independent accuracy measurement
